scope: Current closeClientConnection review: rerun the exact 122 prior TCP/HTTP requests and compare the five prior reset observations, then test the actual helper with nine AF_UNIX stream socket-pair cases. Helper audit uses linker wrappers to count actual successful recv bytes and close calls, cap real reads at 17 bytes for a byte-boundary case, and separately inject EINTR, shutdown failure, timeout-setting failure and receive error. Idle and one-second trickle timings are actual waits, not injected timeouts. Original server pool(1,1), normal 30-second options, and 100ms/one-second/64KiB cleanup policy retained. Excludes actual normal 30-second receive/send timeout reruns, concurrency and full-stage acceptance.

network.scope: Current-source connection-close regression review: 107 prior HTTP cases, with three documented adaptations for newly authorized earlier rejection, 12 partial-prefix/HEAD/4096/4097/query/absolute/method/default-version cases, two buffered-input TCP-close probes, and a recovery request. Loopback temporary port, original pool(1,1), 30-second socket options. Excludes actual timeout tests, concurrency and full-stage acceptance.
